verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of user-defined, condition-triggered behavior is Infra Analytics, which lets users 'set alerts to catch regressions.' That is a thin form of a rule firing an automatic action (a notification) on metric or log events. Autotune's automatic traffic shifting is algorithmic rather than user-defined, and scheduled rollouts are time-based rather than event-based, so neither counts toward this story. missing for 10: documented user-configurable event-triggered automation rules (e.g., auto-disable or rollback of a gate on a metric regression), outbound action targets such as webhooks, detail on how alert rules are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
